name: Twilight Domain
description: A cleric subclass that adds the Twilight tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Bonus Proficiencies
grants.description: Gain proficiency with Martial Weapons and Heavy Armor.

grants.name: Eyes of Night
grants.description: Gain Darkvision out to 300 feet. As an Action, share that range with willing creatures up to your Wisdom modifier for 1 hour; restore the shared use on a Long Rest or by expending a spell slot.

grants.name: Vigilant Blessing
grants.description: As an Action, give one creature Advantage on its next Initiative roll. The blessing ends after that roll or when you bless another creature.

grants.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
grants.description: As an Action, create a 30-foot sphere of twilight for 1 minute. At the end of each ally's turn in it, grant temporary Hit Points equal to 1d6 plus Cleric level or end one Charmed or Frightened effect on that ally.

grants.name: Steps of Night
grants.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, use a Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 minute. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Twilight Shroud
grants.description: You and allies inside your Twilight Sanctuary gain Half Cover.
